description: Release an SMS number: hand it back to the carrier and mark it released. This is IRREVERSIBLE - the number cannot be recovered afterward, any campaign/sequence still explicitly set to send from it will SKIP its SMS sends until repointed at another number, and it stops counting toward the workspace's number limit (freeing a slot for a new purchase). Use get_sms_settings to find the number ID. Requires workspace-management permission.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

numberId.description: SMS number ID returned by get_sms_settings.
